The issue might originate in the parsing stage in src/api/uploads.ts mentioned in the search results, but the exact parsing implementation details are not yet read. Further investigation in the CSV parsing and validation code would help diagnose why uploads from the new accounting export tool are being rejected despite appearing correct in spreadsheet software.
